es: Reescribir un mismo mensaje a una vecina en dos versiones, cercana y distante, eligiendo tiempos que suavizan, distancian o acercan el tono.

teaching.en: Hi, neighbour! Can you water my plants next week? I'll be away from Monday to Friday, and the key is with my brother.
teaching.es: ¡Hola, vecina! ¿Puedes regar mis plantas la semana que viene? Estaré fuera de lunes a viernes y la llave la tiene mi hermano.
teaching.explanationEs: Versión cercana: presente simple, can y frases cortas, como entre amigos.
segments: Hi, neighbour! Can you water my plants next week? I'll be away
from Monday to Friday, and the key is with my brother.
teaching.audioText: Hi, neighbour! Can you water my plants next week? I'll be away from Monday to Friday, and the key is with my brother.

teaching.en: Dear Mrs Green, I was wondering if you could water my plants next week, if it is no trouble, although I realise I'm asking at short notice.
teaching.es: Estimada Sra. Green: me preguntaba si podría regar mis plantas la semana que viene, si no es molestia, aunque sé que se lo pido con poca antelación.
teaching.explanationEs: Versión distante: pasado continuo, could y una fórmula de cortesía; if it is no trouble ofrece una salida.
segments: Dear Mrs Green, I was wondering if you could water my plants next week,
if it is no trouble, although I realise I'm asking at short notice.
teaching.audioText: Dear Mrs Green, I was wondering if you could water my plants next week, if it is no trouble, although I realise I'm asking at short notice.

teaching.en: I hope I'm not being a nuisance, but I would be grateful if you could also keep an eye on the house while I am away.
teaching.es: Espero no ser una molestia, pero le estaría agradecido si además pudiera vigilar la casa mientras estoy fuera.
teaching.explanationEs: I'm being + nombre muestra consideración; keep an eye on es vigilar algo sin encargarse de todo.
segments: I hope I'm not being a nuisance, but I would be grateful if
you could also keep an eye on the house while I am away.
teaching.audioText: I hope I'm not being a nuisance, but I would be grateful if you could also keep an eye on the house while I am away.

teaching.en: I'd gladly bring you some chocolate when I return, and I apologise in advance for any inconvenience this may cause.
teaching.es: Con gusto le traeré chocolate cuando vuelva, y le pido disculpas por adelantado por cualquier inconveniente que esto pueda causar.
teaching.explanationEs: In advance pide perdón antes de molestar; gladly ofrece algo a cambio y return significa volver.
segments: I'd gladly bring you some chocolate when I return, and
I apologise in advance for any inconvenience this may cause.
teaching.audioText: I'd gladly bring you some chocolate when I return, and I apologise in advance for any inconvenience this may cause.

teaching.en: A close version keeps the register informal, with short questions and contractions, while a distant version uses longer, more careful sentences.
teaching.es: Una versión cercana mantiene el registro informal, con preguntas cortas y contracciones, mientras que una versión distante usa frases más largas y cuidadas.
teaching.explanationEs: El registro es el grado de formalidad; cambia según la relación que tienes con quien lees o escuchas.
segments: A close version keeps the register informal, with short questions and
contractions, while a distant version uses longer, more careful sentences.

teaching.en: Choose your tone carefully, because the same request can sound friendly in one version and cold in another if the register is wrong.
teaching.es: Elige bien el tono, porque la misma petición puede sonar amable en una versión y fría en otra si el registro no es el adecuado.
teaching.explanationEs: Tone es la impresión emocional del mensaje; un registro inadecuado estropea el tono aunque la gramática sea correcta.

one version and cold in another if the register is wrong.

prompt.es: Vas a escribir a la Sra. Green, a quien apenas conoces. ¿Qué mensaje eliges?

choices.text: Dear Mrs Green, I was wondering if you could water my plants next week, if it is no trouble.
Hi Mrs Green, can you water my plants next week? Thanks a lot, I'm away from Monday!
Dear Mrs Green, I want you to water my plants next week, because I am away all week.

feedback.es: Con alguien a quien apenas conoces, el pasado continuo, could y if it is no trouble dan la distancia que hace falta.

hint.es: La distancia en el tiempo verbal equivale a distancia social.

prompt.es: Completa: «Espero no ser una molestia, pero ¿podría vigilar mi casa?»

feedback.es: I'm not being a nuisance usa el continuo de actitud para mostrar consideración antes de pedir el favor.

hint.es: Es la palabra para «molestia» o «persona pesada».

origin.text: I hope I'm not being a ___, but could you keep an eye on my house while I am away?

prompt.es: Ordena: «Con gusto le traeré chocolate cuando vuelva.»

answer.text: I'd gladly bring you some chocolate when I return

feedback.es: I'd gladly ofrece algo a cambio y when I return enlaza la promesa con el regreso, sin tiempo futuro tras when.

hint.es: Empieza por la contracción de I would seguida de gladly.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje de voz y elige qué hace Tom para que su petición suene cortés.

choices.text: He praises her by saying that only she can help.
He recognises the effort and offers something in return.
He says it is urgent and cannot be postponed.

feedback.es: Tom admite que es mucho pedir y ofrece chocolate: reconocer el esfuerzo y compensarlo es lo que hace cortés la petición.

origin.audio: Hello, Mrs Green, it's Tom from next door. I'm sorry to call so late. I was wondering whether you could possibly water my plants while I'm away next week. I know it's a lot to ask, and I'd completely understand if you're busy, but I would be very grateful, and I'd gladly bring you some chocolate when I return. There is a spare key with my brother, so there is no need to meet me.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada elemento del mensaje con el registro que marca.

feedback.es: Saludo y cierre fijan el registro: Hi y Thanks a lot marcan cercanía; Dear y Kind regards, distancia y cortesía.

prompt.es: Lee el mensaje. ¿Qué falla en él desde el punto de vista del registro?

choices.text: It is too long and explains too much to someone you hardly know.
It uses a distant tone with a person who is a close friend.
It mixes a formal greeting with a direct request and a casual word.

feedback.es: Dear Mrs Green pide un registro formal, pero can you y mate lo rompen: el mensaje mezcla saludo distante y lenguaje de amigos.

origin.text: Dear Mrs Green, can you water my plants, mate? I'm away next week.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje y elige qué relación sugiere entre quien habla y Anna.

choices.text: A warm friendship between people who help each other.
A formal link between people who hardly know each other.
A tense relationship between people who disagree about something.

feedback.es: Can you, you're being amazing y I promise son marcas de cercanía: el mensaje transmite amistad y confianza, no formalidad ni tensión.

origin.audio: Hey Anna, it's Tom! Can you water my plants next week? I'm away from Monday to Friday, and honestly you're being amazing even before you say yes. The key is with Leo, so just grab it whenever. I'll bring you some chocolate when I'm back, I promise.

prompt.es: Lee el mensaje. ¿Qué papel cumple «I would gladly return the favour»?

choices.text: It reminds her that she promised him a favour before.
It offers something back, so the request feels less one-sided.
It pressures her to decide before he leaves.

feedback.es: Return the favour ofrece devolver la ayuda: así la petición no parece unilateral y mantiene el tono cortés y distante.

origin.text: Dear Mrs Green, I am sorry to ask at such short notice, but I was wondering whether you might be able to keep an eye on my flat while I am away. I would gladly return the favour, and I apologise in advance for any inconvenience.

prompt.es: Completa: «Le estaría muy agradecido si pudiera regar mis plantas.»

feedback.es: I'd be very grateful agradece por adelantado con un registro formal, adecuado para alguien a quien apenas conoces.

origin.text: Dear Mrs Green, I'm sorry to ask at such short notice. I'd be very ___ if you could water my plants next week.

prompt.es: Escribe dos versiones del mensaje: una cercana y otra distante.

answer.text: Version 1: Hi Anna! Can you water my plants next week? I'm away from Monday to Friday, and you're being amazing about it. The key is with my brother, so there is no need to meet. I'll bring you some chocolate when I'm back. Thanks a lot! Version 2: Dear Mrs Green, I was wondering if you could water my plants next week, if it is no trouble. I'm away from Monday to Friday, and I was hoping you could also keep an eye on the house. I hope I'm not being a nuisance, and I apologise in advance for any inconvenience. I would be very grateful, and I'd gladly bring you some chocolate when I return. Kind regards, Tom

Close version: Hey Anna! Could you water my plants next week? I'm away from Monday to Friday, and you're being amazing to do this for me. I'll leave the key with my brother, and I'll buy you a coffee when I'm back. Thanks so much! Distant version: Dear Ms Green, I was hoping you could water my plants next week, if it is no trouble. I'm going away from Monday to Friday, and I hope I'm not being a nuisance by asking at short notice. I would be very grateful, and I'd gladly bring you a small gift when I return. Please accept my apologies in advance for any inconvenience. Yours sincerely, Tom

Version 1: Hi Anna, can you water my plants this week? I'm away from Monday to Friday, and you're being a real friend, honestly. The spare key is with my brother, so just ask him. I'll bring you chocolate on Saturday! Version 2: Dear Mr Brown, I was wondering if you could water my plants next week, as I'm away from Monday to Friday. I hope I'm not being a nuisance, and I would be very grateful for your help. I'd gladly return the favour whenever you need it, and I apologise in advance for the inconvenience. Best wishes, Tom

feedback.es: Las dos versiones piden lo mismo, pero la cercana usa presente y can y la distante suma pasado continuo, could, agradecimiento y cierre formal.

origin.text: Viajas de lunes a viernes y necesitas que te rieguen las plantas y vigilen la casa. Escribe en inglés (140–190 palabras) dos mensajes: la versión 1, cercana, para tu amiga Anna; la versión 2, distante, para la Sra. Green, a quien apenas conoces. Incluye un tiempo de distancia (was wondering / was hoping), un continuo de actitud (I hope I'm not being…), una fórmula de agradecimiento y un saludo y cierre acordes con cada registro.

evidenceGroups: i hope i am not being

prompt.es: Lee el correo. ¿Qué postura adopta el inquilino en la última frase?

choices.text: He demands a discount and gives a final deadline.
He apologises for having paid the rent late before.
He asks for a favour without expecting it to be accepted.

feedback.es: I fully understand if this is not convenient da al propietario una salida: el inquilino pide un favor sin exigirlo ni presionar.

origin.text: Dear Mr Brooks, I hope this message finds you well. I was wondering whether it might be possible to postpone the rent until next Monday, as I'm still waiting for a payment. I fully understand if this is not convenient, and I'd be grateful for any help with the date.

prompt.es: Completa: «Mia se dio cuenta de que su registro era demasiado informal.»

feedback.es: Register es el grado de formalidad de lo que escribes; un registro informal con un jefe rompe la distancia que exige la situación.

origin.text: Mia wrote 'Hey, give me a hand, will you?' to her boss and then realised that her ___ was far too informal.

answer.text: Would it be possible to keep an eye on my house

feedback.es: Would it be possible to + verbo base es una petición muy cortés; keep an eye on forma un bloque fijo con el sentido de vigilar.
